source.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source.license: Freely available for private, academic and commercial use
source.interpretation: 60-arc-second cell-area grid. Heights are original Float32 metres relative to EGM2008. Greenland and Antarctica show ice surface, not subglacial bedrock. Modern undated reference; no dated historical terrain reconstruction.

grid.verticalReference: EGM2008 geoid (EPSG:3855); approximates mean sea level, not a local tidal datum
